candidates.description: This vector represents armed conflict and physical combat.
This vector represents the concept of change, progression, or modulation in state, degree, or quantity.
This feature vector represents adverbs of approximation, degree, and qualification.
This feature vector represents verbs and actions related to causation, influence, and instigation.
This vector activates on words related to monarchs, empires, and forms of sovereign or military governance.
This vector represents interpersonal or international relationships, encompassing both allies and adversaries.
These tokens represent major geographical regions, seas, and oceans of the world.
This feature vector represents the concept of military invasion, hostile takeover, and aggressive incursions.
This feature vector represents commitments, obligations, and the setting of expectations or demands.
This feature vector represents the concept of being held captive, imprisoned, or detained, along with related rescue and containment actions.
